questions.question_english: A Principal discovers that a nearby unauthorized school continues to teach 50 students even after its recognition has been withdrawn. What should the competent educational authority do?
options_english: Impose the prescribed daily fine for continued operation and arrange transfer of the 50 students to recognized schools
Allow the school to continue until the end of the academic year without further action
Issue only an advisory to the management, without action regarding the children
Transfer children only if their parents submit a fresh admission application
questions.explanation_english: Impose daily fines for continuing operation and relocate the 50 students to recognized schools. When an unrecognized school continues operations after recognition withdrawal, the competent authority must enforce Section 19(5) by levying daily statutory fines up to ten thousand rupees while taking administrative measures under Section 18 to re-enroll and transfer the fifty students to nearby recognized neighbourhood schools.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A है। मान्यता वापस लिए जाने के बाद भी विद्यालय चलाना अधिनियम का उल्लंघन है और इसके लिए निर्धारित दंड लगाया जा सकता है। साथ ही, विद्यालय बंद होने या संचालन की मान्यता न रहने से बच्चों की शिक्षा बाधित नहीं होनी चाहिए, इसलिए उन्हें मान्यता-प्राप्त विद्यालयों में स्थानांतरित करने की व्यवस्था जरूरी है। केवल प्रबंधन को चेतावनी देना या माता-पिता पर नई आवेदन प्रक्रिया का भार डालना पर्याप्त नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Impose the prescribed daily fine for continued operation and arrange transfer of the 50 students to recognized schools

Impose daily fines for continuing operation and relocate the 50 students to recognized schools. When an unrecognized school continues operations after recognition withdrawal, the competent authority must enforce Section 19(5) by levying daily statutory fines up to ten thousand rupees while taking administrative measures under Section 18 to re-enroll and transfer the fifty students to nearby recognized neighbourhood schools.

questions.question_english: Which of the following is NOT specified as a mandatory norm or standard for a school under the Schedule of the RTE Act?
options_english: A fully equipped computer laboratory
A dedicated kitchen facility where mid-day meal is cooked safely in the school
A school library providing daily newspapers, magazines, and age-appropriate books

questions.explanation_english: A fully equipped computer laboratory is not specified as a mandatory Schedule norm in the formulation tested by this question. The Schedule identifies baseline provisions such as an all-weather building, classrooms, separate toilets, safe drinking water, a kitchen for the mid-day meal, a library and barrier-free access. Digital equipment may be beneficial, but it should not be confused with the statutory minimum facilities explicitly listed in the Schedule.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर पूरी तरह सुसज्जित कंप्यूटर प्रयोगशाला है। RTE अनुसूची में भवन, कक्षा-कक्ष, शौचालय, पेयजल, रसोईघर, पुस्तकालय और दिव्यांग बच्चों के लिए बाधा-मुक्त पहुँच जैसे न्यूनतम मानक निर्धारित हैं। कंप्यूटर प्रयोगशाला उपयोगी शैक्षिक सुविधा हो सकती है, लेकिन प्रश्न में उल्लिखित अनुसूची के अनिवार्य न्यूनतम मानकों में इसे उसी रूप में निर्दिष्ट नहीं किया गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A fully equipped computer laboratory

questions.question_english: A Principal in a government school in a dense urban slum area finds that the school has exceeded the maximum capacity sanctioned by fire and safety norms. However, neighbourhood children continue to seek admission. What is the most appropriate action for the Principal under the RTE framework?
options_english: Deny further admissions strictly citing mandatory municipal fire safety norms and officially declare zero remaining capacity.
Admit all applicant children unconditionally but restrict their physical attendance to alternate days on a rotational basis.
Forward applications to the local authority to arrange alternative neighbourhood schooling so no child is denied admission.

questions.explanation_english: Under the statutory framework, no child seeking elementary admission can be denied entry. options_english: To foster social inclusion and equity by integrating children from diverse socio- economic backgrounds.
To intentionally create severe financial strain and force non-compliant private schools into bankruptcy.
To permanently transfer all performing students from public government schools to private institutions.
To provide a formal legal rationale for private school managements to increase overall annual fees.
questions.explanation_english: To foster social inclusion and equity by integrating children from diverse socio-economic backgrounds. Reserving 25% entry-level seats under Section 12(1)(c) aims to promote social integration, equity, and diversity. Educating children from weaker sections alongside privileged peers in shared classroom spaces reduces socio-economic segregation and builds inclusive educational environments from foundational schooling years.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर सामाजिक समावेशन और समानता को बढ़ावा देना है। 25% प्रवेश प्रावधान का उद्देश्य कमजोर वर्गों और वंचित समूहों के बच्चों को निजी गैर-सहायता-प्राप्त विद्यालयों में प्रवेश का अवसर देना तथा विभिन्न सामाजिक-आर्थिक पृष्ठभूमियों के बच्चों को साथ सीखने का अवसर प्रदान करना है। यह प्रावधान निजी विद्यालयों को दिवालिया बनाने या फीस बढ़ाने के लिए नहीं बनाया गया है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) To foster social inclusion and equity by integrating children from diverse socio- economic backgrounds.

To foster social inclusion and equity by integrating children from diverse socio-economic backgrounds. Reserving 25% entry-level seats under Section 12(1)(c) aims to promote social integration, equity, and diversity. Educating children from weaker sections alongside privileged peers in shared classroom spaces reduces socio-economic segregation and builds inclusive educational environments from foundational schooling years.

options_hindi: EWS विद्यार्थियों को अलग कक्षाओं में बैठाना
कमजोर विद्यार्थियों के लिए उपचारात्मक कक्षाएँ आयोजित करना
विद्यार्थियों को आयु के आधार पर कक्षाओं में समूहित करना

questions.question_english: Under Section 8(c), the appropriate Government must ensure that the child belonging to weaker section and the child belonging to disadvantaged group are not segregated or discriminated against. This effectively prohibits:
options_english: Seating EWS students in separate classrooms.
Holding remedial classes for weak students.
Grouping students by age.
Organizing inter-house sports competitions.
questions.explanation_english: Section 8(c) obligates the appropriate Government to ensure that children from weaker sections and disadvantaged groups are not segregated or discriminated against. Seating EWS quota students in separate classrooms or shifts is strictly prohibited, mandating full classroom integration alongside general entry peers.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर EWS विद्यार्थियों को अलग कक्षाओं में बैठाना है। धारा 8(ग) का उद्देश्य कमजोर वर्गों और वंचित समूहों के विद्यार्थियों के साथ समान व्यवहार और वास्तविक समावेशन सुनिश्चित करना है। उन्हें सामाजिक या आर्थिक पहचान के आधार पर अलग कक्षाओं में रखना भेदभाव और पृथक्करण होगा। सीखने में कठिनाई वाले बच्चों के लिए उपचारात्मक कक्षाएँ आयोजित करना अपने आप में निषिद्ध नहीं है, यदि वह भेदभावपूर्ण अलगाव के रूप में न हो।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Seating EWS students in separate classrooms.

Section 8(c) obligates the appropriate Government to ensure that children from weaker sections and disadvantaged groups are not segregated or discriminated against. Seating EWS quota students in separate classrooms or shifts is strictly prohibited, mandating full classroom integration alongside general entry peers.

questions.question_english: Which of the following statements is correct regarding the duty of parents under Section 10 of the RTE Act?
options_english: Every parent or guardian must admit their child or ward to an elementary school in the neighbourhood.
Parents failing to send their children to school regularly shall be liable for monetary fines under the statutory provisions of the Act.
Parents must make a compulsory nominal financial contribution to the School Management Committee for school infrastructure maintenance.
It is the primary duty of parents to independently arrange and fund private academic support if their child requires special training.
questions.explanation_english: Section 10 establishes that it is the fundamental duty of every parent or guardian to admit their child or ward to an elementary school in the neighbourhood. The statute consciously avoids imposing financial penalties, fines, or prosecution on parents, focusing instead on community empowerment and government accountability to ensure universal admission, regular attendance, and completion.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A है। धारा 10 माता-पिता या अभिभावक से अपेक्षा करती है कि वे बच्चे को पड़ोस के विद्यालय में प्रारंभिक शिक्षा के लिए प्रवेश दिलाएँ। अधिनियम इस कर्तव्य को पूरा न करने पर माता-पिता के लिए स्वतः आर्थिक जुर्माने का प्रावधान नहीं करता। विद्यालय की आधारभूत संरचना के लिए अनिवार्य योगदान माँगना या विशेष प्रशिक्षण का खर्च माता-पिता पर डाल देना इस वैधानिक कर्तव्य का सही अर्थ नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Every parent or guardian must admit their child or ward to an elementary school in the neighbourhood.

Section 10 establishes that it is the fundamental duty of every parent or guardian to admit their child or ward to an elementary school in the neighbourhood. The statute consciously avoids imposing financial penalties, fines, or prosecution on parents, focusing instead on community empowerment and government accountability to ensure universal admission, regular attendance, and completion.

questions.question_english: The RTE Act Schedule specifies that there should be at least one classroom for every teacher. This is to ensure:
options_english: Teachers avoid sharing instructional space, ensuring optimal learning environments.
Multi-grade and combined classroom teaching practices are actively promoted across all state schools.
School buildings are constructed as physically large as municipal land permits.
The administrative Head teacher is assigned an exclusive private office room.
questions.explanation_english: Mandating at least one classroom per teacher ensures dedicated physical teaching space for every class group. This structural standard eliminates disruptive multi-grade room sharing, reduces noise interference, and supports focused instructional delivery within conducive learning environments.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प A है। प्रत्येक शिक्षक के लिए कक्षा-कक्ष का मानक यह सुनिश्चित करने में मदद करता है कि शिक्षण के लिए उपयुक्त स्थान उपलब्ध हो और कक्षाओं की अत्यधिक साझेदारी से अधिगम प्रभावित न हो। इसका उद्देश्य बड़ी इमारतें बनाना या प्रधान शिक्षक के लिए निजी कार्यालय सुनिश्चित करना नहीं है। बहु-कक्षा शिक्षण की आवश्यकता विद्यालय के संदर्भ में हो सकती है, लेकिन वह इस मानक का मुख्य उद्देश्य नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Teachers avoid sharing instructional space, ensuring optimal learning environments.

Mandating at least one classroom per teacher ensures dedicated physical teaching space for every class group. This structural standard eliminates disruptive multi-grade room sharing, reduces noise interference, and supports focused instructional delivery within conducive learning environments.

questions.question_english:
Read the following assertion (A) and reason (R) statements and select the correct option:
Assertion (A): The Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) prescribed by the RTE Act is lower for primary schools compared to upper primary schools.
Reason (R): Younger children in primary classes require more individual attention and closer pedagogical support.
options_english: Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A
Both A and R are true but R is not the correct explanation of A
A is true but R is false
A is false but R is true
questions.explanation_english: The statutory Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) prescribed in the Schedule is 30:1 for primary classes (Classes 1-5) and 35:1 for upper primary classes (Classes 6-8). A ratio of 30:1 means fewer pupils per teacher, reflecting a lower numerical ratio at the primary level. However, reason statements misinterpreting basic standard numerical comparisons make standalone logical options correct.
questions.explanation_hindi: इस प्रश्न की मुद्रित उत्तर-कुंजी विकल्प C देती है: अभिकथन सही, कारण गलत। PTR का संख्यात्मक मान प्राथमिक स्तर पर सामान्यतः उच्च प्राथमिक की तुलना में कम निर्धारित है, जिसका अर्थ है कि प्रति शिक्षक विद्यार्थियों की संख्या सीमित रखी जाती है। हालांकि छोटे बच्चों को अधिक व्यक्तिगत ध्यान की आवश्यकता संबंधी कारण एक सामान्य शैक्षणिक तर्क है, यह आवश्यक नहीं कि अधिनियम ने इसे उस अनुपात का प्रत्यक्ष वैधानिक कारण बताया हो। परीक्षा के लिए मुद्रित कुंजी और वैधानिक अनुसूची के बीच इस भेद को ध्यान में रखें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) A is true but R is false

The statutory Pupil-Teacher Ratio (PTR) prescribed in the Schedule is 30:1 for primary classes (Classes 1-5) and 35:1 for upper primary classes (Classes 6-8). A ratio of 30:1 means fewer pupils per teacher, reflecting a lower numerical ratio at the primary level. However, reason statements misinterpreting basic standard numerical comparisons make standalone logical options correct.

questions.subject: UPSC Principal Paper
questions.question_english:
Consider the following key objectives and features of the RTE Act, 2009:
I. Ensuring free and compulsory education to all children of India in the 6 to 14 years age group.
II. Prohibition of unrecognised schools from operation.
III. Laying down minimum norms and standards for school infrastructure and teachers.
IV. Guaranteeing free higher secondary education to students belonging to disadvantaged groups. Which of the above statements represent the correct objectives and features of the RTE Act?
options_english: I, II and III
I, III and IV
II, III and IV
I, II, III and IV
questions.explanation_english: The primary features of the legislation include guaranteeing free and compulsory elementary education to children aged six to fourteen, mandating school recognition, and establishing essential infrastructure and teacher norms. Higher secondary education is not covered under this mandate, as the statutory scope of elementary education is strictly confined from Class 1 through Class 8 for the specified age bracket.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I, II और III है। RTE अधिनियम का मूल दायरा 6 से 14 वर्ष के बच्चों की प्रारंभिक शिक्षा है। यह विद्यालयों की मान्यता तथा अनुसूची में दिए गए आधारभूत संरचना और शिक्षक-संबंधी न्यूनतम मानकों को भी निर्धारित करता है। अधिनियम सभी वंचित विद्यार्थियों को निःशुल्क उच्चतर माध्यमिक शिक्षा की सार्वभौमिक गारंटी नहीं देता; इसलिए कथन IV अधिनियम के दायरे से बाहर है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) I, II and III

The primary features of the legislation include guaranteeing free and compulsory elementary education to children aged six to fourteen, mandating school recognition, and establishing essential infrastructure and teacher norms. Higher secondary education is not covered under this mandate, as the statutory scope of elementary education is strictly confined from Class 1 through Class 8 for the specified age bracket.
